metadata.description: Adaptive spec-driven development for Claude Code.

plugins.name: compass
plugins.description: Enough process for the work at hand. No more. Compass assesses each change by risk, familiarity and size, then picks the approach to match: what to write, what to check, and when to ask a human. A typo fix stays light. A payments rewrite gets specs, tests and review. Five guardrails apply to every change that ships code, such as a passing test for each one.
